# Vendored third-party libraries

Self-hosted (no CDN) static assets used by `knowledge/internal/server/static/index.html`.

## markdown-it

- Version: 15.0.2
- License: MIT
- Source: https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it
- File: `markdown-it.min.js`, from that release's `dist/browser/markdown-it.umd.min.js`

## DOMPurify

- Version: 3.4.15
- License: (MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0)
- Source: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify
- File: `purify.min.js`, from that release's `dist/purify.min.js`
